title: RedactedContent
description: Redacted plaintext of one captured interaction (opt-in content capture, PRP-99): the document PRP-102 encrypts. It exists only in memory between redaction and encryption and after an audited decrypt; it is never an event, audit, index or notification field and no schema references it. Redaction replaces each detection with the placeholder `[[ns-redacted:<detected_category>]]`. Every text is secret-free: JSON Schema rejects text containing a private-key block, JWT, bearer token, AWS access key id, GitHub token, sk- key, Azure storage or Service Bus key assignment, SAS signature or URL with userinfo. The same patterns are mirrored by the Python validator check_secret_free_text in tests/contracts/validators.py, which PRP-101 must keep a subset of its credential detectors. redaction_state is `redacted` or `not_required` only; content whose redaction failed is not representable here. Pydantic ignores `not` (ADR-0004): validate against the JSON Schema before encryption.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document, major 1 with additive minor revisions.

interaction_id.description: Interaction this content belongs to (lowercase UUID).

redaction_state.description: `redacted`: detectors ran and replaced detections. `not_required`: detectors ran and found nothing to replace. No other state is storable.

detector_set_version.description: Version of the deterministic detector set that produced this redaction.

parts.description: One part per ContentPartKind, at most five.

redacted_part.title: RedactedPart
redacted_part.description: One redacted content part with its detection findings.

truncated.description: True when the text was cut to the capture policy's max_part_chars.

secret_free_text.description: Redacted text, 0 to 32768 characters, that matches none of the known credential formats (patterns are ECMA-262 compatible, no lookbehind). Mirrored by check_secret_free_text.

anyOf.description: Azure storage or Service Bus key assignment

detection_finding.title: DetectionFinding
detection_finding.description: One detector result for one content part of an interaction (opt-in content capture, PRP-99). A fragment: it has no schema_version of its own and is embedded by RedactedContent (and, in later items, the interaction record). It carries a category, counts and offsets into the redacted text, never the matched text. Rule JSON Schema expresses with if/then: a credential category (CredentialCategory) requires action `replaced`; a credential can never be kept. Pydantic ignores if/then (ADR-0004), so consumers validate against the JSON Schema.

detector_id.description: Detector that produced the finding (lowercase slug).

detector_version.description: Detector version, semantic version without prefix.

count.description: Number of matches of this category in the part.

action.description: What redaction did with the matches: `replaced` with a placeholder, or `kept` as written (only for non-credential categories a capture policy keeps).

spans.description: Character offsets of the matches into the redacted text of the part. Offsets only; never the matched text.

allOf.description: A credential category is always replaced, never kept.

detection_finding__credential_category.title: CredentialCategory
detection_finding__credential_category.description: Categories that are credentials. Closed set: always replaced, never kept, and never listed in a capture policy's kept categories.

detection_finding__detected_category.title: DetectedCategory
detection_finding__detected_category.description: Kind of sensitive content a detector found; open-ended: readers must tolerate unknown values. The first eight are credential categories (CredentialCategory).

detection_finding__part_kind.title: ContentPartKind
detection_finding__part_kind.description: Which part of an interaction a piece of content is.
